answer: Social Matters >> Clothing & Lifestyle Question ID: 8673 Country: Canada Title: Is it Sunnah to keep the top button of one's shirt or the button on one's collar open? Question: Is it Sunnah to keep the top button of one's shirt or the button on one's collar open? Answer ID: 8673 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1469/1224=L/1429) It is proved from hadith that the Prophet ( صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم ) sometimes used to keep his neck collar open. Some of the Sahaba liked it so much that they made it their habit: عن معاویۃ بن مرہ عن ابیہ رضی اللہ عنہ قال: اتیت رسول اللہ صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم فی رھط من مزینۃ و ان قمیصہ لمطلق او قال زر قمیصہ ( شمائل الترمذی 5 ) قال عروۃ: فما رایت معاویۃ ولا ابنہ الا مطلقی ازارھما فی شتاء ولاحر ولا یزرران ازارھما ( ابو داود کتاب اللباس ) It is to be noted that it is difficult to say it about shirts; since shirt in itself is not the Sunnah clothing. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
